يعتدون (form VIII)
# يَعْتَدُونَ (yaʕtadūna) /jaʕ.ta.duː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَدَى (iʕtadā)
# يُعْتَدَوْنَ (yuʕtadawna) /juʕ.ta.daw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَدَى (iʕtadā)
